summary: Preserved candidate PR 2577's metric-scope note while correcting three independently reproduced false implications: TPOT excludes TTFT, ITL samples stream events and can omit the terminal tail, and whole-run client output throughput is a different estimator from recent-window engine throughput and need not match exactly.

tests.what_was_measured: Against exact candidate 3516408f3178b64300fb78bc28064bed9c653931: 100 ms TPOT versus 490 ms whole-request/token; 8 ITL samples for 9 post-first tokens; 0.8 s ITL sum versus 0.9 s decode phase; 2.04 tok/s whole-run versus 20 tok/s synthetic recent-window throughput.
The corrected scope assertions failed twice on the candidate's whole-request-lifetime wording.
Two focused wording regressions passed after the correction.
The independent arithmetic boundary case continued to pass with the corrected note.

gpu_execution_evidence: Not used: the justified change is output wording determined by deterministic client metric arithmetic and engine reporting-window source formulas.
remaining_limitations: The original Qwen2.5-0.5B weights and NVIDIA H800/CUDA environment were unavailable.
The original 2048-input/256-output concurrency-16 absolute performance workload was not reproduced.
No claim is made about cross-model or cross-vendor absolute throughput.
